sites.reason: Reviewed deferral: this file lock is a kernel-level mutual exclusion held across a potentially slow operation. Replacing it with a nonblocking claim changes the caller into a reschedule loop, so it lands with the reservation and bounded-retry protocol in its own package rather than as a flag change here.
